title: Common definitions
description: Single-source vocabulary for DEVAI contracts. Schemas reference these definitions instead of restating them inline.

execution_status_core.$comment: Lowercase values are execution-status outcomes; uppercase values are judgment verdicts. Context-specific extensions remain local to their consuming schemas.

substrate.$comment: Article 4 — the five fundamental substrates. Every artifact in a repo belongs to exactly one.

anyOf.title: Specification
anyOf.description: The reference signal: business specs, engineering specs, invariants, trace, ADRs, glossary, contracts.

anyOf.title: Plant
anyOf.description: Application code under control: source, migrations, configuration, IaC, build scripts.

anyOf.title: Observation
anyOf.description: Sensors: tests at all levels, plus executable-sensor configurations that encode intent.

anyOf.title: Inventory
anyOf.description: Plant-identification artifacts, derived deterministically from F1-F3. Never authored.

anyOf.title: Harness
anyOf.description: The DEVAI machinery as instantiated in the repo: pinned constitution, materialized config, runtime state.

transversal.$comment: Article 5 — the nine transversal properties. substrate x transversal = the 45-cell aspect grid; some cells are degenerate (N/A).

anyOf.title: Coverage
anyOf.description: How completely the substrate addresses its subject.

anyOf.title: Coherence
anyOf.description: Internal consistency; parts agree with each other.

anyOf.title: Alignment
anyOf.description: Agreement with the reference signal above it.

anyOf.title: Idiomaticity
anyOf.description: Conformance to the declared stack's and framework's idioms.

anyOf.title: Security and Privacy
anyOf.description: Protection of assets and data across the substrate.

anyOf.title: Robustness
anyOf.description: Behavior under failure, edge cases, and adverse input.

anyOf.title: Discipline
anyOf.description: Process health: the substrate is maintained the way the law says it is.

examples.$comment: defs-only schema; example shows a $ref consumer fragment
